lesson: The trade failed because the 555 level acted as a liquidity sweep rather than a structural resistance, causing a stop-run before the intended move. The system incorrectly prioritized bearish macro structure over the immediate SMC liquidity grab at the 555 level.
adjustment: Require a confirmed Market Structure Shift (MSS) on the 15m timeframe below the liquidity sweep level before entering shorts, rather than entering on the touch of a structural level.
methodology_flag: Trust SMC liquidity sweeps more than macro bearish structure on BNBUSDT.
